purpose: Execute the first deliberately narrow completed-U1 production-feedback canary inside pinned CLASS: perform a deterministic opt-in direct handoff at the certified a_on, suppress the historical legacy nlde perturbation carrier allocation from the completed state, initialize the complete C10.65s1 finite state through the source-locked initialization path, feed the certified completed-U1 projector/first-RHS quantities into the real Newtonian-gauge production path, and advance exactly one accepted short integrator step on one certified completion point across the four exact low-k anchors. This gate measures preferred A/H/M constraint drift but does not turn that first measurement into a post-hoc long-time stability threshold.

canary_domain.completion_point_selection: first persisted C10.65n completion point; selection is frozen before s2 implementation

runtime_contract.deterministic_handoff_site: perturb_solve interval boundary after perturb_vector_init and before generic_evolver
runtime_contract.arbitrary_a_on_policy: split the containing interval at deterministic tau_on without changing approximation criteria
runtime_contract.initial_state_source: C10.65s1 completed finite state only; active higher UR multipoles may use the observed s1 HIGHER_ORDER_HISTORICAL_CONTROL values solely to complete the historical canary state and are not promoted to a UV prediction
runtime_contract.ordinary_state_initialization_policy: ordinary photon/baryon/UR/metric scalar coordinates must enter through perturb_initial_conditions / perturb_vector_init ownership, not through ad-hoc mutation inside perturb_derivs; any implementation requiring a new post-vector handoff write beyond the C10.65s0-certified carrier slots is out of scope and must first receive a separate architecture proof
runtime_contract.legacy_nlde_auxiliary_policy: do not import or initialize dU,dUprime,dV,dVprime,dZ,dZprime as completed-U1 physical perturbations; suppress their historical completed-state role in the opt-in canary
allowed_production_feedback_after_handof: completed-U1 Newtonian metric/projector algebraic outputs on the opt-in s2 path
completed-U1 first RHS values certified by C10.65r2 for the corresponding production derivative slots
forbidden: ad-hoc post-vector mutation of photon, baryon, UR, metric or higher-hierarchy integrated coordinates at tau_on
state mutation from inside an adaptive RHS callback except normal dy evaluation by the integrator
changing TCA/RSA/UFA switching criteria or collision coefficients
changing approximation interval boundaries except the explicit deterministic tau_on split
consuming historical CLASS phi/psi or legacy dU/dV/dZ values as completed-U1 boundary data
adding an independent temporal, metric or shift datum
expanding beyond the frozen one-point x four-anchor canary

step_contract.constraint_drift_acceptance_policy: measurement-only in s2: require finite, reproducibly defined before/after residuals and report signed/absolute/normalized change; do not infer finite-time stability or freeze a numerical drift bound from the same execution being tested
step_contract.next_gate_policy: if s2 passes, freeze a separate finite-short-interval stability gate with its numerical constraint-drift tolerance fixed before that later integration run

interpretation_if_pass: At one frozen completion point and four exact low-k anchors, pinned CLASS can perform a deterministic opt-in completed-U1 onset handoff, use the certified completed projector/first-RHS quantities in the actual production derivative path, and survive one accepted short step with finite state and explicitly measured preferred A/H/M constraint drift while preserving exact OFF rollback. This is the first production-feedback canary only; it is not a finite-time stability proof.
next_if_pass: Freeze a separate C10.65s3 finite-short-interval completed-U1 stability target using the s2 drift diagnostics only to choose a prospective tolerance before any s3 execution; then test multiple accepted steps / a finite interval on the same one-point x four-anchor domain before widening parameter or k coverage.
non_claims: not a UV derivation of the historical higher hierarchy
not proof of a unique primordial growing mode
not resolution of C9 radiative naturalness, broader C7, or B9
